content.short: Ankr provides RPC endpoints, blockchain data access, and developer tooling for teams building and scaling apps on Mantle.
content.description: Ankr runs blockchain infrastructure that helps developers connect apps to networks through RPC endpoints, node services, and related Web3 tooling. Its Mantle support gives teams access to JSON-RPC methods for reading chain data, broadcasting transactions, tracing activity, and building backend services without operating their own nodes. Ankr also offers SDKs and APIs that simplify app development, making it a practical choice for wallets, analytics products, and other services that need dependable Mantle connectivity at scale.
content.meta: Ankr provides RPC endpoints, node access, and developer tooling that helps Mantle apps connect reliably and scale their infrastructure.
